div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note: This list provides identification of those persons mentioned most frequently in the volume. The list generally covers only the years 1958–1960. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. Where no dates are given, the person usually held the position throughout the period. In some cases, it has not been possible to determine all positions held.
